from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

ROOT = Path.home() / ".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
TASK_ID = "A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-20261006-R1"
RESULT = ROOT / "model_results" / f"{TASK_ID}.json"
REQUEST = ROOT / "requests" / f"{TASK_ID}.json"
EXPECTED_ROUTE = "SESSION-ROUTE-756bff225d5a976edf6da02b"
EXPECTED_CANDIDATE = "AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d"
REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
    "candidate_id",
    "proposal_version",
    "hypothesis",
    "falsification",
    "data_and_time_scope",
    "units",
    "method",
    "leakage_and_bias",
    "scoring",
    "execution_assumptions_and_costs",
    "success_criteria",
    "failure_criteria",
    "reproducibility",
    "intended_artifacts",
    "safety",
    "scientific_limitations",
}

def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

deadline = time.monotonic() + 600
while not RESULT.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
    time.sleep(5)

if not RESULT.exists():
    raise SystemExit("SOL_MODEL_RESULT_TIMEOUT")

result = json.loads(RESULT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
expected = {
    "schema": "PVA_GOVERNED_MODEL_COMPLETION_V1",
    "task_id": TASK_ID,
    "phase": "SOL_PROPOSAL",
    "model": "gpt-5.6-sol",
    "model_policy": "SOL_EXACT",
    "route_task_id": EXPECTED_ROUTE,
    "campaign_id": "FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4",
}
for key, value in expected.items():
    if result.get(key) != value:
        raise SystemExit(f"SOL_RESULT_{key.upper()}_MISMATCH:{result.get(key)!r}")

if not REQUEST.is_file() or REQUEST.is_symlink():
    raise SystemExit("SOL_REQUEST_MISSING_OR_SYMLINK")
if result.get("request_sha256") != sha256(REQUEST):
    raise SystemExit("SOL_REQUEST_HASH_MISMATCH")

checkpoint = str(result.get("checkpoint") or "")
run_dir = (ROOT / checkpoint).resolve()
root_resolved = ROOT.resolve()
if not run_dir.is_relative_to(root_resolved):
    raise SystemExit("SOL_CHECKPOINT_OUTSIDE_CAMPAIGN")
worker = run_dir / "WORKER.json"
complete = run_dir / "COMPLETE.json"
if not worker.is_file() or worker.is_symlink():
    raise SystemExit("SOL_WORKER_EVIDENCE_MISSING")
if not complete.is_file() or complete.is_symlink():
    raise SystemExit("SOL_COMPLETE_EVIDENCE_MISSING")
if result.get("worker_sha256") != sha256(worker):
    raise SystemExit("SOL_WORKER_HASH_MISMATCH")
if result.get("completion_sha256") != sha256(complete):
    raise SystemExit("SOL_COMPLETION_HASH_MISMATCH")

worker_obj = json.loads(worker.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if worker_obj.get("model") != "gpt-5.6-sol":
    raise SystemExit("SOL_WORKER_WRONG_MODEL")
selection = worker_obj.get("model_selection")
if not isinstance(selection, dict) or selection.get("policy") != "SOL_EXACT" or selection.get("selected_slug") != "gpt-5.6-sol":
    raise SystemExit("SOL_WORKER_SELECTION_INVALID")

final = result.get("final")
if not isinstance(final, str) or not final.strip():
    raise SystemExit("SOL_FINAL_MISSING")
try:
    proposal = json.loads(final)
except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
    raise SystemExit(f"SOL_FINAL_NOT_PURE_JSON:{exc}")

if not isinstance(proposal, dict):
    raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_NOT_OBJECT")
missing = sorted(REQUIRED_FIELDS - set(proposal))
if missing:
    raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_FIELDS_MISSING:" + ",".join(missing))
if proposal.get("candidate_id") != EXPECTED_CANDIDATE:
    raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_CANDIDATE_MISMATCH")
if proposal.get("proposal_version") != 1:
    raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_VERSION_MISMATCH")

for key in REQUIRED_FIELDS - {"candidate_id", "proposal_version"}:
    value = proposal.get(key)
    if value in (None, "", [], {}):
        raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_FIELD_EMPTY:" + key)

safety = proposal.get("safety")
if not isinstance(safety, dict):
    raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_SAFETY_NOT_OBJECT")
for key in ("live_trading", "paid_actions", "wallet_actions"):
    if safety.get(key) is not False:
        raise SystemExit("SOL_PROPOSAL_SAFETY_INVALID:" + key)

proposal_sha = hashlib.sha256(
    json.dumps(proposal, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
).hexdigest()

print("SOL_PROPOSAL_VERIFIED=1")
print("SOL_MODEL=gpt-5.6-sol")
print("SOL_POLICY=SOL_EXACT")
print("SOL_PROPOSAL_VERSION=1")
print("SOL_PROPOSAL_SHA256=" + proposal_sha)
print("SOL_RESULT_PATH=" + str(RESULT))
print("NEXT_GATE=ASTRA_PREBUILD")
